designs.headline_654_30x5: 654 hosts, outer resamples r = 0-29 x seeds 0-4

payload.label: re-tuned descriptor network D*, dretrain_v2, spec sha256 c33cfa33aac3ed56c46c9802abbf70f63e7b030386043f233e5761c9b9b60f65; within-host spread, within-host Spearman, within-host residual gap, forest crossover and within-host skill on the estimators of the records quoted for the previous descriptor network D

sign_convention.D_minus_Dstar: positive = D* more accurate (MAE) or D higher (Spearman)
sign_convention.Dstar_minus_RF: negative = D* more accurate than the forest
sign_convention.S_minus_Dstar: positive = D* more accurate (MAE) or S higher (Spearman)
sign_convention.within_host_skill: zero-skill within-host residual MAE minus the network's; positive = skill

bootstrap.paired: S, D, v1, v2 share each group's draws

definitions.bader_rank: hosts with >= 2 tested sites and non-constant desc_bader_charge: lowest = host minimum (most negative), highest = host maximum, middle = strictly between
definitions.cation: every element other than O; elements in >= 15 tested hosts
definitions.mae: mean |p - y| over the group's sites
definitions.prediction: seed-ensemble mean (seeds 0-2) per (model, r, site), averaged over the resamples in which the site's host was tested
definitions.signed_residual: mean of (p - host mean p) - (y - host mean y) over the same sites
definitions.small_n: groups with < 10 hosts: flag, no interval; an interval only if >= 10 hosts contribute to the metric
definitions.spearman: per host with >= 3 tested sites, Spearman(p, y) with average ranks; NaN (excluded, counted) if p or y is constant; mean over hosts
definitions.within_host_mae: per host with >= 2 tested sites: |(p - host mean p) - (y - host mean y)|, host means over all tested sites; mean over the group's sites in such hosts
definitions.zero_skill_mae: |y - host mean y| over the same sites as within_host_mae
